about: The 25 critical acceptance scenarios of document 10 §3, each with the tests that prove it. Checked by scripts/verify-acceptance.mjs: the wording must be the specification's, every named test must exist under platform/tests, every line must be a row of document 14.

states.proven: the rule is in the code and the named tests prove it
states.partly: part of it is proven; the note says what is not, and the lines close it
states.not_built: the module does not exist in the Laravel admin

scenarios.text: A public enquiry creates one lead.

tests.name: captures a web enquiry as contact + lead with normalised phone and attribution
joins a repeat enquiry from the same phone to the open lead instead of duplicating it

scenarios.note: Proven on the Laravel enquiry address. The React shop's forms still write to the old API, so no public enquiry reaches Laravel yet.

scenarios.text: Duplicate detection identifies likely existing contact.

tests.name: refuses a duplicate phone in any format and points to the existing contact
merges a duplicate contact and moves its leads and timeline

scenarios.note: By phone number, however it is written. Several numbers and e-mail addresses per person come later.

scenarios.text: Lead assignment is permission checked and audited.

tests.name: lets a manager reassign the lead
does not let a sales user act on another person's lead
bulk assigns, moves and deletes selected leads within permissions
writes nothing when a lead is given to the person who has it already

scenarios.note: A reassignment asks for a reason and writes it into the lead's history. Pressed in a browser: the sale journey hands a lead over twice and finds the reason on its timeline.

scenarios.text: Estimate totals are calculated server-side.

tests.name: prices an estimate from the rate book with an honest essential-to-premium band
prices rate book lines at today's rates inside the same computation
applies line discounts, quote discount, other charges, tax and rounding in order

scenarios.note: The arithmetic runs on the server and is tested. The Estimations screen is switched off: its rate book is Interior's, and Furniture's rates are not in yet.

scenarios.text: Quote approval is required for configured roles/thresholds.

tests.name: measures the discount against the sender's role limit and the minimum margin
blocks sending above the limit until a manager approves exactly those figures
lists pending approvals for managers and lets them decide

scenarios.note: The limits in force are defaults. The owner's own limit for each role is still to come. Pressed in a browser: a sales person with a 5% limit cannot send 8% off, asks, and the sales manager approves from the queue.

scenarios.text: A rejected quote cannot be converted.

tests.name: rechecks the persisted acceptability of a stale sent quotation
does not open projects or advances from unaccepted quotes
records a no with the reason, leaves the lead alone, and the quotation can be revised
refuses an answer for a quotation that is not with the client

scenarios.note: A declined, expired, void or draft quotation cannot be accepted, and no project or invoice is created from it. Since 17 November a member of staff can record the client's no, with the reason; it opens nothing.

scenarios.text: Issued document snapshot remains stable after product price changes.

tests.name: copies rate book items into the quote so later rate changes do not alter it
serves the exact frozen quote PDF by default after sending
returns the same advance and never re-freezes an existing issued PDF

scenarios.note: Proven for rate-book lines and for the frozen PDF. A quotation line cannot yet be chosen from the product catalogue, so a product's price change is not tested.

scenarios.text: Payment amount cannot exceed allowed allocation unless overpayment policy is defined.

tests.name: refuses to collect more than is outstanding
spreads a payment over the oldest invoices first and keeps the rest as credit
validates the whole explicit map before retaining any allocation or receipt
refuses a payment larger than the balance

scenarios.note: The policy in force: from an invoice no more than is outstanding can be collected; money received beyond the invoices it settles is kept as the client's credit.

scenarios.text: Partial payments calculate outstanding balance correctly.

tests.name: spreads a payment over the oldest invoices first and keeps the rest as credit
pays the preferred invoice before older debt and retains only the final excess as credit
preserves paisa exactly and refuses scientific or overprecise amounts on the staff form
splits a part-settled receipt between receivables and client credit
writes a payment taken by accounts, and says where the invoice then stands

scenarios.note: Pressed in a browser: 372,600 paid against an invoice of 496,800 leaves 124,200 and the status Partially Paid.

scenarios.text: Reversal requires permission and reason.

tests.name: voids an issued invoice with a reason and reverses its ledger entry instead of deleting it
requires a reason before voiding
does not offer the void to a sales user, and refuses it if called
lets the owner post and reverse a manual entry from the journals screen, and blocks the admin

scenarios.text: Financial reports reconcile to source transactions.

tests.name: leaves the trial balance balanced after bills and payments
shows the posted accounts with their debits, credits and a balanced total
reconciles today and business-line collections without counting unallocated cash twice

scenarios.note: The books balance after every tested posting, and the day's collections reconcile. Not every report states its definition and is tested against its source records.

scenarios.text: Currency and tax behavior are explicit.

tests.name: never allocates to non-payable or foreign-currency invoice targets
keeps the tax rate of the quotation on the advance
splits sales tax to taxes payable when the quotation carries it

scenarios.note: Quotations and invoices carry their currency and their tax rate. There are no tax rules and no currency setting: PKR is written into the code and tax is a rate typed per document.

scenarios.text: Goods receipt posts stock once only.
scenarios.note: No purchasing or stock module in Laravel. The rule and its test exist in the Node system (`scripts/test-stock-ledger.mjs`) and are ported first.

scenarios.text: Duplicate receipt submission is idempotent.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Transfer creates matched source and destination ledger movements.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Reservation reduces available stock but does not corrupt physical stock.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Adjustment requires reason and appropriate approval.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Unauthorized user cannot access editor or draft preview.
scenarios.note: No Puck editor exists. The Website Studio in the code is the HTML builder inherited from Interior, and it is switched off.

scenarios.text: Unsupported component types are rejected by server.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Draft save creates a new revision.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Preview uses same renderer as published page.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Publish requires appropriate role/approval.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Rollback restores previous valid revision.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Product block uses canonical catalogue data.
scenarios.note: As above.

scenarios.text: Media deletion is blocked or warns when referenced.

tests.name: reuses an existing library image and blocks deleting connected images

scenarios.note: Proven in the media library for images that the catalogue uses. Pages cannot refer to media yet: there is no Puck editor.
